info.name: Estate Data Collection (EDC) API
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman test kit for the Estate Data Collection (EDC) Azure Functions platform (Public & Admin Function Apps).

Covers:
0. Health & Version Observability (GET /api/about)
1. Admin Schema & Multi-Engine Verification (POST /api/schemas/verify — always 200 OK report with issues by severity, analyzerFindings, engineTraces, validationPolicy, ambientFixtures; GET /api/schemas/engines; CCD Elemental Dataset v3 ODCS v3.2.0)
2. Admin Schema Ingestion, Lifecycle Tombstone & Sign-Off (Invalid .error.json, DELETE tombstone + 409 Conflict guard -> v+1, Unvalidated + PATCH .../signoff -> Validated, Schedule & Catalogue)
3. Public Schema Discovery & Catalogue (GET /api/schemas, GET /api/schemas/{schemaName}, GET /api/schemas/{schemaName}/versions/{version})
4. CDC Survey Submission Lifecycle (Drafts with severity-grouped issues -> Ready -> Finalised /{submissionId}/payload.json bundle)
5. ODCS v3.2.0 Survey Sites Workflow (edc-survey-sites)
6. CDC Survey Multi-Step Validation Pipeline (cdc_survey with 10 Quality Rules)
7. CCD Elemental Dataset v3 Workflow (ccd-elemental-v3 with reference data, cross-submission site/block integrity, CEL/JsonLogic/unique rules, and processed bundle layout)

body.raw:
{
  "fileName": "ccd-elemental-v3.odcs.yaml",
  "odcsYaml": "version: "3.0.0"
kind: DataContract
apiVersion: v3.2.0

id: ccd-elemental-v3
name: ccd-elemental-v3
status: draft

domain: capital-delivery
tenant: DfE

customProperties:
  - property: failOnMinimumSeverity
    value: Error
  - property: crossSubmissionDraftPolicy
    value: WarnOnDraftReferences

servers:
  - server: databricks
    type: databricks
    environment: dev
    description: CCD Elemental Dataset v3 stored in Databricks Silver layer
    catalog: eed_catalogue_30_bronze
    schema: cde_edc_integration

description:
  purpose: >
    Captures DfE Capital Condition Data (CCD) Elemental Dataset v3 submissions including
    survey metadata, establishment identifier, surveyed elements, occurrences, replacement data,
    and multi-year repair schedules.
  usage: >
    Used for public collection, multi-engine quality validation (JsonLogic, CEL, unique),
    cross-submission site/block integrity, and reference-data verification.
  limitations: >
    Binary photo attachment upload and Microsoft Defender malware scanning are handled separately
    by the upload manifest workflow; this contract validates photoReference format and requiredness.

schema:
  - name: submission
    logicalType: object
    description: Top-level CCD Elemental Dataset v3 payload container
    quality:
      - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-006
        type: custom
        engine: cel
        severity: CRITICAL
        stage: 10
        order: 4
        stopOnFailure: true
        path: "/"
        description: Submission must contain at least one surveyed element.
        message: Submission must contain at least one element in 'elements'.
        implementation: "size(this.elements) > 0"

    properties:
      - name: survey
        logicalType: object
        required: true
        quality:
          - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-003
            type: custom
            engine: jsonlogic
            severity: CRITICAL
            stage: 10
            order: 1
            stopOnFailure: true
            path: survey
            description: Survey updatedAt timestamp must be greater than or equal to createdAt.
            message: Survey updatedAt cannot precede createdAt.
            implementation:
              ">=":
                - var: survey.updatedAt
                - var: survey.createdAt

          - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-004
            type: custom
            engine: cel
            severity: CRITICAL
            stage: 10
            order: 2
            stopOnFailure: true
            path: survey
            description: Core survey identifiers (id, surveyName, participantId) must be non-empty.
            message: Survey id, surveyName, and participantId must be populated.
            implementation: "size(this.id) > 0 && size(this.surveyName) > 0 && size(this.participantId) > 0"

          - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-056
            type: custom
            engine: cel
            severity: ERROR
            stage: 20
            order: 10
            path: survey
            description: Completed surveys must include a surveyorEmail contact address.
            message: surveyorEmail is required when survey.isComplete is true.
            implementation: "!this.isComplete || (has(this.surveyorEmail) && this.surveyorEmail != null && size(this.surveyorEmail) > 0)"

        properties:
          - name: id
            physicalType: string
            logicalType: string
            required: true
            logicalTypeOptions:
              pattern: "^SURV-[A-Za-z0-9-]+$"

          - name: surveyName
            physicalType: string
            logicalType: string
            required: true

          - name: participantId
            physicalType: string
            logicalType: string
            required: true

          - name: surveyorEmail
            physicalType: string
            logicalType: string
            required: false
            logicalTypeOptions:
              format: email

          - name: surveyDate
            physicalType: string
            logicalType: date
            required: true

          - name: isComplete
            physicalType: boolean
            logicalType: boolean
            required: true

          - name: createdAt
            physicalType: string
            logicalType: timestamp
            required: true

          - name: updatedAt
            physicalType: string
            logicalType: timestamp
            required: true

      - name: school
        logicalType: object
        required: true
        quality:
          - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-005
            type: custom
            engine: cel
            severity: CRITICAL
            stage: 10
            order: 3
            stopOnFailure: true
            path: school
            description: Establishment identifier value must be non-empty.
            message: Establishment identifier (school.urn) must not be blank.
            implementation: "size(this.urn) > 0"

        properties:
          - name: urn
            physicalType: string
            logicalType: string
            required: true

          - name: name
            physicalType: string
            logicalType: string
            required: true

          - name: localAuthorityCode
            physicalType: string
            logicalType: string
            required: false

      - name: elements
        logicalType: array
        required: true
        items:
          logicalType: object
          required: true
          quality:
            - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-001
              type: custom
              engine: cel
              severity: ERROR
              stage: 20
              order: 1
              dependsOn:
                - CCD-ELEM-V3-006
              path: "elements[]"
              description: Element productType must exist in the authoritative CCD reference catalogue.
              message: productType is not present in the CCD reference dataset.
              implementation: "this.productType in ambient.reference.product_types"

            - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-007
              type: custom
              engine: cel
              severity: ERROR
              stage: 20
              order: 2
              dependsOn:
                - CCD-ELEM-V3-006
              path: "elements[]"
              description: Element nrm3Code must exist in the NRM3 reference dataset.
              message: nrm3Code is not present in the NRM3 reference dataset.
              implementation: "this.nrm3Code in ambient.reference.nrm3_codes"

            - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-008
              type: custom
              engine: cel
              severity: ERROR
              stage: 20
              order: 3
              dependsOn:
                - CCD-ELEM-V3-006
              path: "elements[]"
              description: Element siteId must match a site identifier in sibling cross-submission records.
              message: siteId was not found in cross-submission known_site_ids for this establishment.
              implementation: "this.siteId in ambient.cross_submission.known_site_ids"

            - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-009
              type: custom
              engine: cel
              severity: ERROR
              stage: 20
              order: 4
              dependsOn:
                - CCD-ELEM-V3-008
              path: "elements[]"
              description: Non-site elements must reference a valid blockId from sibling cross-submission records.
              message: blockId must be provided and exist in cross-submission known_block_ids when assetType is block, floor, or space.
              implementation: "this.assetType == 'site' || (has(this.blockId) && this.blockId != null && this.blockId in ambient.cross_submission.known_block_ids)"

            - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-010
              type: custom
              engine: cel
              severity: ERROR
              stage: 20
              order: 5
              path: "elements[]"
              description: Floor-level elements must specify floorId.
              message: floorId is required when assetType is 'floor'.
              implementation: "this.assetType != 'floor' || (has(this.floorId) && this.floorId != null && size(this.floorId) > 0)"

            - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-011
              type: custom
              engine: cel
              severity: ERROR
              stage: 20
              order: 6
              path: "elements[]"
              description: Space-level elements must specify both floorId and spaceId.
              message: floorId and spaceId are required when assetType is 'space'.
              implementation: "this.assetType != 'space' || (has(this.floorId) && this.floorId != null && size(this.floorId) > 0 && has(this.spaceId) && this.spaceId != null && size(this.spaceId) > 0)"

            - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-012
              type: custom
              engine: jsonlogic
              severity: ERROR
              stage: 20
              order: 7
              path: "elements[]"
              description: Elements marked as notAssessed must provide a non-empty notAssessedReason.
              message: notAssessedReason is required when notAssessed is true.
              implementation:
                "if":
                  - "==":
                      - var: notAssessed
                      - true
                  - "and":
                      - "!=":
                          - var: notAssessedReason
                          - null
                      - ">":
                          - var: notAssessedReason.length
                          - 0
                  - true

            - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-013
              type: custom
              engine: cel
              severity: ERROR
              stage: 20
              order: 8
              path: "elements[]"
              description: Assessed elements (notAssessed != true) must contain at least one occurrence.
              message: Assessed elements must include at least one occurrence.
              implementation: "(has(this.notAssessed) && this.notAssessed == true) || (has(this.occurrences) && this.occurrences != null && size(this.occurrences) > 0)"

            - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-014
              type: unique
              engine: unique
              severity: ERROR
              stage: 20
              order: 9
              path: "elements[]"
              description: Element id must be unique across the submission.
              message: Duplicate element id detected in submission.
              fields:
                - id

            - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-015
              type: custom
              engine: cel
              severity: WARNING
              stage: 20
              order: 10
              path: "elements[]"
              description: Elements marked notAssessed should not normally contain occurrences.
              message: Element is marked notAssessed but still includes occurrences.
              implementation: "!(has(this.notAssessed) && this.notAssessed == true) || !has(this.occurrences) || this.occurrences == null || size(this.occurrences) == 0"

          properties:
            - name: id
              physicalType: string
              logicalType: string
              required: true
              logicalTypeOptions:
                pattern: "^ELM-[A-Za-z0-9-]+$"

            - name: nrm3Code
              physicalType: string
              logicalType: string
              required: true

            - name: productType
              physicalType: string
              logicalType: string
              required: true

            - name: elementCategory
              physicalType: string
              logicalType: string
              required: true
              enum:
                - value: Fabric
                - value: Mechanical
                - value: Electrical
                - value: External
                - value: Special

            - name: assetType
              physicalType: string
              logicalType: string
              required: true
              enum:
                - value: site
                - value: block
                - value: floor
                - value: space

            - name: siteId
              physicalType: string
              logicalType: string
              required: true

            - name: blockId
              physicalType: string
              logicalType: string
              required: false

            - name: floorId
              physicalType: string
              logicalType: string
              required: false

            - name: spaceId
              physicalType: string
              logicalType: string
              required: false

            - name: notAssessed
              physicalType: boolean
              logicalType: boolean
              required: false

            - name: notAssessedReason
              physicalType: string
              logicalType: string
              required: false

            - name: occurrences
              logicalType: array
              required: false
              items:
                logicalType: object
                quality:
                  - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-016
                    type: custom
                    engine: cel
                    severity: ERROR
                    stage: 30
                    order: 1
                    dependsOn:
                      - CCD-ELEM-V3-001
                    path: "elements[].occurrences[]"
                    description: Assessed element occurrences must specify basisOfAssessment.
                    message: basisOfAssessment is required for assessed element occurrences.
                    implementation: "(has($parent.notAssessed) && $parent.notAssessed == true) || (has(this.basisOfAssessment) && this.basisOfAssessment != null)"

                  - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-017
                    type: custom
                    engine: cel
                    severity: ERROR
                    stage: 30
                    order: 2
                    path: "elements[].occurrences[]"
                    description: Assessed element occurrences must specify conditionGrade.
                    message: conditionGrade is required for assessed element occurrences.
                    implementation: "(has($parent.notAssessed) && $parent.notAssessed == true) || (has(this.conditionGrade) && this.conditionGrade != null)"

                  - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-018
                    type: custom
                    engine: cel
                    severity: ERROR
                    stage: 30
                    order: 3
                    dependsOn:
                      - CCD-ELEM-V3-017
                    path: "elements[].occurrences[]"
                    description: Condition grades B, C, and D require a descriptive conditionDescription (min 5 chars).
                    message: conditionDescription (minimum 5 characters) is required when conditionGrade is B, C, or D.
                    implementation: "!(has(this.conditionGrade) && this.conditionGrade in ['B', 'C', 'D']) || (has(this.conditionDescription) && this.conditionDescription != null && size(this.conditionDescription) >= 5)"

                  - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-002
                    type: custom
                    engine: cel
                    severity: ERROR
                    stage: 30
                    order: 4
                    dependsOn:
                      - CCD-ELEM-V3-017
                    path: "elements[].occurrences[]"
                    description: Grade C or D occurrences must declare a photoReference (binary attachment existence verified by upload manifest workflow).
                    message: photoReference is required when conditionGrade is C or D.
                    implementation: "!(has(this.conditionGrade) && this.conditionGrade in ['C', 'D']) || (has(this.photoReference) && this.photoReference != null && size(this.photoReference) > 0)"

                  - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-020
                    type: custom
                    engine: cel
                    severity: ERROR
                    stage: 30
                    order: 5
                    dependsOn:
                      - CCD-ELEM-V3-017
                    path: "elements[].occurrences[]"
                    description: Grade D (Life Expired) occurrences must include at least one repair item.
                    message: At least one repair entry is required when conditionGrade is D.
                    implementation: "!(has(this.conditionGrade) && this.conditionGrade == 'D') || (has(this.repairs) && this.repairs != null && size(this.repairs) > 0)"

                  - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-021
                    type: custom
                    engine: cel
                    severity: WARNING
                    stage: 30
                    order: 6
                    dependsOn:
                      - CCD-ELEM-V3-017
                    path: "elements[].occurrences[]"
                    description: Grade C (Poor) occurrences should normally include at least one repair item.
                    message: Grade C occurrence does not include any repair entries.
                    implementation: "!(has(this.conditionGrade) && this.conditionGrade == 'C') || (has(this.repairs) && this.repairs != null && size(this.repairs) > 0)"

                  - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-022
                    type: custom
                    engine: cel
                    severity: ERROR
                    stage: 30
                    order: 7
                    path: "elements[].occurrences[]"
                    description: Grade A occurrences may only carry priorityGrade '1' when specified.
                    message: Grade A occurrence cannot have a priorityGrade above 1.
                    implementation: "!(has(this.conditionGrade) && this.conditionGrade == 'A' && has(this.priorityGrade) && this.priorityGrade != null) || this.priorityGrade == '1'"

                  - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-023
                    type: custom
                    engine: cel
                    severity: ERROR
                    stage: 30
                    order: 8
                    path: "elements[].occurrences[]"
                    description: Grade D occurrences must carry priorityGrade '3' or '4'.
                    message: Grade D occurrence must specify priorityGrade '3' or '4'.
                    implementation: "!(has(this.conditionGrade) && this.conditionGrade == 'D') || (has(this.priorityGrade) && this.priorityGrade in ['3', '4'])"

                  - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-024
                    type: custom
                    engine: cel
                    severity: ERROR
                    stage: 30
                    order: 9
                    path: "elements[].occurrences[]"
                    description: Assumed ('Not Seen') occurrences must explain the basis in conditionDescription.
                    message: conditionDescription is required when basisOfAssessment is 'Not Seen'.
                    implementation: "!(has(this.basisOfAssessment) && this.basisOfAssessment == 'Not Seen') || (has(this.conditionDescription) && this.conditionDescription != null && size(this.conditionDescription) > 0)"

                  - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-025
                    type: custom
                    engine: cel
                    severity: WARNING
                    stage: 30
                    order: 10
                    path: "elements[].occurrences[]"
                    description: Suspected asbestos occurrences should include explanatory notes in conditionDescription.
                    message: conditionDescription should be populated when hasAsbestosSuspected is true.
                    implementation: "!(has(this.hasAsbestosSuspected) && this.hasAsbestosSuspected == true) || (has(this.conditionDescription) && this.conditionDescription != null && size(this.conditionDescription) > 0)"

                  - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-027
                    type: custom
                    engine: cel
                    severity: ERROR
                    stage: 30
                    order: 11
                    path: "elements[].occurrences[]"
                    description: Condition score when provided must be between 0 and 100 inclusive.
                    message: conditionScore must be between 0 and 100.
                    implementation: "!has(this.conditionScore) || this.conditionScore == null || (this.conditionScore >= 0.0 && this.conditionScore <= 100.0)"

                  - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-028
                    type: custom
                    engine: cel
                    severity: WARNING
                    stage: 30
                    order: 12
                    path: "elements[].occurrences[]"
                    description: Grade A occurrences should normally have a conditionScore of at least 85.
                    message: Grade A occurrence has a conditionScore below 85.
                    implementation: "!(has(this.conditionGrade) && this.conditionGrade == 'A' && has(this.conditionScore) && this.conditionScore != null) || this.conditionScore >= 85.0"

                  - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-029
                    type: custom
                    engine: cel
                    severity: WARNING
                    stage: 30
                    order: 13
                    path: "elements[].occurrences[]"
                    description: Grade D occurrences should normally have a conditionScore of 25 or lower.
                    message: Grade D occurrence has a conditionScore above 25.
                    implementation: "!(has(this.conditionGrade) && this.conditionGrade == 'D' && has(this.conditionScore) && this.conditionScore != null) || this.conditionScore <= 25.0"

                  - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-030
                    type: custom
                    engine: cel
                    severity: ERROR
                    stage: 30
                    order: 14
                    path: "elements[].occurrences[]"
                    description: Occurrence surveyLevel must align with parent element assetType.

  "odcsYaml": "version: "3.0.0"
kind: DataContract
apiVersion: v3.2.0

id: ccd-elemental-v3
name: ccd-elemental-v3
status: draft

domain: capital-delivery
tenant: DfE

customProperties:
  - property: failOnMinimumSeverity
    value: Error
  - property: crossSubmissionDraftPolicy
    value: WarnOnDraftReferences

servers:
  - server: databricks
    type: databricks
    environment: dev
    description: CCD Elemental Dataset v3 stored in Databricks Silver layer
    catalog: eed_catalogue_30_bronze
    schema: cde_edc_integration

description:
  purpose: >
    Captures DfE Capital Condition Data (CCD) Elemental Dataset v3 submissions including
    survey metadata, establishment identifier, surveyed elements, occurrences, replacement data,
    and multi-year repair schedules.
  usage: >
    Used for public collection, multi-engine quality validation (JsonLogic, CEL, unique),
    cross-submission site/block integrity, and reference-data verification.
  limitations: >
    Binary photo attachment upload and Microsoft Defender malware scanning are handled separately
    by the upload manifest workflow; this contract validates photoReference format and requiredness.

schema:
  - name: submission
    logicalType: object
    description: Top-level CCD Elemental Dataset v3 payload container
    quality:
      - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-006
        type: custom
        engine: cel
        severity: CRITICAL
        stage: 10
        order: 4
        stopOnFailure: true
        path: "/"
        description: Submission must contain at least one surveyed element.
        message: Submission must contain at least one element in 'elements'.
        implementation: "size(this.elements) > 0"

    properties:
      - name: survey
        logicalType: object
        required: true
        quality:
          - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-003
            type: custom
            engine: jsonlogic
            severity: CRITICAL
            stage: 10
            order: 1
            stopOnFailure: true
            path: survey
            description: Survey updatedAt timestamp must be greater than or equal to createdAt.
            message: Survey updatedAt cannot precede createdAt.
            implementation:
              ">=":
                - var: survey.updatedAt
                - var: survey.createdAt

          - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-004
            type: custom
            engine: cel
            severity: CRITICAL
            stage: 10
            order: 2
            stopOnFailure: true
            path: survey
            description: Core survey identifiers (id, surveyName, participantId) must be non-empty.
            message: Survey id, surveyName, and participantId must be populated.
            implementation: "size(this.id) > 0 && size(this.surveyName) > 0 && size(this.participantId) > 0"

          - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-056
            type: custom
            engine: cel
            severity: ERROR
            stage: 20
            order: 10
            path: survey
            description: Completed surveys must include a surveyorEmail contact address.
            message: surveyorEmail is required when survey.isComplete is true.
            implementation: "!this.isComplete || (has(this.surveyorEmail) && this.surveyorEmail != null && size(this.surveyorEmail) > 0)"

        properties:
          - name: id
            physicalType: string
            logicalType: string
            required: true
            logicalTypeOptions:
              pattern: "^SURV-[A-Za-z0-9-]+$"

          - name: surveyName
            physicalType: string
            logicalType: string
            required: true

          - name: participantId
            physicalType: string
            logicalType: string
            required: true

          - name: surveyorEmail
            physicalType: string
            logicalType: string
            required: false
            logicalTypeOptions:
              format: email

          - name: surveyDate
            physicalType: string
            logicalType: date
            required: true

          - name: isComplete
            physicalType: boolean
            logicalType: boolean
            required: true

          - name: createdAt
            physicalType: string
            logicalType: timestamp
            required: true

          - name: updatedAt
            physicalType: string
            logicalType: timestamp
            required: true

      - name: school
        logicalType: object
        required: true
        quality:
          - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-005
            type: custom
            engine: cel
            severity: CRITICAL
            stage: 10
            order: 3
            stopOnFailure: true
            path: school
            description: Establishment identifier value must be non-empty.
            message: Establishment identifier (school.urn) must not be blank.
            implementation: "size(this.urn) > 0"

        properties:
          - name: urn
            physicalType: string
            logicalType: string
            required: true

          - name: name
            physicalType: string
            logicalType: string
            required: true

          - name: localAuthorityCode
            physicalType: string
            logicalType: string
            required: false

      - name: elements
        logicalType: array
        required: true
        items:
          logicalType: object
          required: true
          quality:
            - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-001
              type: custom
              engine: cel
              severity: ERROR
              stage: 20
              order: 1
              dependsOn:
                - CCD-ELEM-V3-006
              path: "elements[]"
              description: Element productType must exist in the authoritative CCD reference catalogue.
              message: productType is not present in the CCD reference dataset.
              implementation: "this.productType in ambient.reference.product_types"

            - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-007
              type: custom
              engine: cel
              severity: ERROR
              stage: 20
              order: 2
              dependsOn:
                - CCD-ELEM-V3-006
              path: "elements[]"
              description: Element nrm3Code must exist in the NRM3 reference dataset.
              message: nrm3Code is not present in the NRM3 reference dataset.
              implementation: "this.nrm3Code in ambient.reference.nrm3_codes"

            - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-008
              type: custom
              engine: cel
              severity: ERROR
              stage: 20
              order: 3
              dependsOn:
                - CCD-ELEM-V3-006
              path: "elements[]"
              description: Element siteId must match a site identifier in sibling cross-submission records.
              message: siteId was not found in cross-submission known_site_ids for this establishment.
              implementation: "this.siteId in ambient.cross_submission.known_site_ids"

            - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-009
              type: custom
              engine: cel
              severity: ERROR
              stage: 20
              order: 4
              dependsOn:
                - CCD-ELEM-V3-008
              path: "elements[]"
              description: Non-site elements must reference a valid blockId from sibling cross-submission records.
              message: blockId must be provided and exist in cross-submission known_block_ids when assetType is block, floor, or space.
              implementation: "this.assetType == 'site' || (has(this.blockId) && this.blockId != null && this.blockId in ambient.cross_submission.known_block_ids)"

            - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-010
              type: custom
              engine: cel
              severity: ERROR
              stage: 20
              order: 5
              path: "elements[]"
              description: Floor-level elements must specify floorId.
              message: floorId is required when assetType is 'floor'.
              implementation: "this.assetType != 'floor' || (has(this.floorId) && this.floorId != null && size(this.floorId) > 0)"

            - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-011
              type: custom
              engine: cel
              severity: ERROR
              stage: 20
              order: 6
              path: "elements[]"
              description: Space-level elements must specify both floorId and spaceId.
              message: floorId and spaceId are required when assetType is 'space'.
              implementation: "this.assetType != 'space' || (has(this.floorId) && this.floorId != null && size(this.floorId) > 0 && has(this.spaceId) && this.spaceId != null && size(this.spaceId) > 0)"

            - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-012
              type: custom
              engine: jsonlogic
              severity: ERROR
              stage: 20
              order: 7
              path: "elements[]"
              description: Elements marked as notAssessed must provide a non-empty notAssessedReason.
              message: notAssessedReason is required when notAssessed is true.
              implementation:
                "if":
                  - "==":
                      - var: notAssessed
                      - true
                  - "and":
                      - "!=":
                          - var: notAssessedReason
                          - null
                      - ">":
                          - var: notAssessedReason.length
                          - 0
                  - true

            - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-013
              type: custom
              engine: cel
              severity: ERROR
              stage: 20
              order: 8
              path: "elements[]"
              description: Assessed elements (notAssessed != true) must contain at least one occurrence.
              message: Assessed elements must include at least one occurrence.
              implementation: "(has(this.notAssessed) && this.notAssessed == true) || (has(this.occurrences) && this.occurrences != null && size(this.occurrences) > 0)"

            - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-014
              type: unique
              engine: unique
              severity: ERROR
              stage: 20
              order: 9
              path: "elements[]"
              description: Element id must be unique across the submission.
              message: Duplicate element id detected in submission.
              fields:
                - id

            - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-015
              type: custom
              engine: cel
              severity: WARNING
              stage: 20
              order: 10
              path: "elements[]"
              description: Elements marked notAssessed should not normally contain occurrences.
              message: Element is marked notAssessed but still includes occurrences.
              implementation: "!(has(this.notAssessed) && this.notAssessed == true) || !has(this.occurrences) || this.occurrences == null || size(this.occurrences) == 0"

          properties:
            - name: id
              physicalType: string
              logicalType: string
              required: true
              logicalTypeOptions:
                pattern: "^ELM-[A-Za-z0-9-]+$"

            - name: nrm3Code
              physicalType: string
              logicalType: string
              required: true

            - name: productType
              physicalType: string
              logicalType: string
              required: true

            - name: elementCategory
              physicalType: string
              logicalType: string
              required: true
              enum:
                - value: Fabric
                - value: Mechanical
                - value: Electrical
                - value: External
                - value: Special

            - name: assetType
              physicalType: string
              logicalType: string
              required: true
              enum:
                - value: site
                - value: block
                - value: floor
                - value: space

            - name: siteId
              physicalType: string
              logicalType: string
              required: true

            - name: blockId
              physicalType: string
              logicalType: string
              required: false

            - name: floorId
              physicalType: string
              logicalType: string
              required: false

            - name: spaceId
              physicalType: string
              logicalType: string
              required: false

            - name: notAssessed
              physicalType: boolean
              logicalType: boolean
              required: false

            - name: notAssessedReason
              physicalType: string
              logicalType: string
              required: false

            - name: occurrences
              logicalType: array
              required: false
              items:
                logicalType: object
                quality:
                  - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-016
                    type: custom
                    engine: cel
                    severity: ERROR
                    stage: 30
                    order: 1
                    dependsOn:
                      - CCD-ELEM-V3-001
                    path: "elements[].occurrences[]"
                    description: Assessed element occurrences must specify basisOfAssessment.
                    message: basisOfAssessment is required for assessed element occurrences.
                    implementation: "(has($parent.notAssessed) && $parent.notAssessed == true) || (has(this.basisOfAssessment) && this.basisOfAssessment != null)"

                  - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-017
                    type: custom
                    engine: cel
                    severity: ERROR
                    stage: 30
                    order: 2
                    path: "elements[].occurrences[]"
                    description: Assessed element occurrences must specify conditionGrade.
                    message: conditionGrade is required for assessed element occurrences.
                    implementation: "(has($parent.notAssessed) && $parent.notAssessed == true) || (has(this.conditionGrade) && this.conditionGrade != null)"

                  - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-018
                    type: custom
                    engine: cel
                    severity: ERROR
                    stage: 30
                    order: 3
                    dependsOn:
                      - CCD-ELEM-V3-017
                    path: "elements[].occurrences[]"
                    description: Condition grades B, C, and D require a descriptive conditionDescription (min 5 chars).
                    message: conditionDescription (minimum 5 characters) is required when conditionGrade is B, C, or D.
                    implementation: "!(has(this.conditionGrade) && this.conditionGrade in ['B', 'C', 'D']) || (has(this.conditionDescription) && this.conditionDescription != null && size(this.conditionDescription) >= 5)"

                  - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-002
                    type: custom
                    engine: cel
                    severity: ERROR
                    stage: 30
                    order: 4
                    dependsOn:
                      - CCD-ELEM-V3-017
                    path: "elements[].occurrences[]"
                    description: Grade C or D occurrences must declare a photoReference (binary attachment existence verified by upload manifest workflow).
                    message: photoReference is required when conditionGrade is C or D.
                    implementation: "!(has(this.conditionGrade) && this.conditionGrade in ['C', 'D']) || (has(this.photoReference) && this.photoReference != null && size(this.photoReference) > 0)"

                  - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-020
                    type: custom
                    engine: cel
                    severity: ERROR
                    stage: 30
                    order: 5
                    dependsOn:
                      - CCD-ELEM-V3-017
                    path: "elements[].occurrences[]"
                    description: Grade D (Life Expired) occurrences must include at least one repair item.
                    message: At least one repair entry is required when conditionGrade is D.
                    implementation: "!(has(this.conditionGrade) && this.conditionGrade == 'D') || (has(this.repairs) && this.repairs != null && size(this.repairs) > 0)"

                  - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-021
                    type: custom
                    engine: cel
                    severity: WARNING
                    stage: 30
                    order: 6
                    dependsOn:
                      - CCD-ELEM-V3-017
                    path: "elements[].occurrences[]"
                    description: Grade C (Poor) occurrences should normally include at least one repair item.
                    message: Grade C occurrence does not include any repair entries.
                    implementation: "!(has(this.conditionGrade) && this.conditionGrade == 'C') || (has(this.repairs) && this.repairs != null && size(this.repairs) > 0)"

                  - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-022
                    type: custom
                    engine: cel
                    severity: ERROR
                    stage: 30
                    order: 7
                    path: "elements[].occurrences[]"
                    description: Grade A occurrences may only carry priorityGrade '1' when specified.
                    message: Grade A occurrence cannot have a priorityGrade above 1.
                    implementation: "!(has(this.conditionGrade) && this.conditionGrade == 'A' && has(this.priorityGrade) && this.priorityGrade != null) || this.priorityGrade == '1'"

                  - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-023
                    type: custom
                    engine: cel
                    severity: ERROR
                    stage: 30
                    order: 8
                    path: "elements[].occurrences[]"
                    description: Grade D occurrences must carry priorityGrade '3' or '4'.
                    message: Grade D occurrence must specify priorityGrade '3' or '4'.
                    implementation: "!(has(this.conditionGrade) && this.conditionGrade == 'D') || (has(this.priorityGrade) && this.priorityGrade in ['3', '4'])"

                  - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-024
                    type: custom
                    engine: cel
                    severity: ERROR
                    stage: 30
                    order: 9
                    path: "elements[].occurrences[]"
                    description: Assumed ('Not Seen') occurrences must explain the basis in conditionDescription.
                    message: conditionDescription is required when basisOfAssessment is 'Not Seen'.
                    implementation: "!(has(this.basisOfAssessment) && this.basisOfAssessment == 'Not Seen') || (has(this.conditionDescription) && this.conditionDescription != null && size(this.conditionDescription) > 0)"

                  - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-025
                    type: custom
                    engine: cel
                    severity: WARNING
                    stage: 30
                    order: 10
                    path: "elements[].occurrences[]"
                    description: Suspected asbestos occurrences should include explanatory notes in conditionDescription.
                    message: conditionDescription should be populated when hasAsbestosSuspected is true.
                    implementation: "!(has(this.hasAsbestosSuspected) && this.hasAsbestosSuspected == true) || (has(this.conditionDescription) && this.conditionDescription != null && size(this.conditionDescription) > 0)"

                  - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-027
                    type: custom
                    engine: cel
                    severity: ERROR
                    stage: 30
                    order: 11
                    path: "elements[].occurrences[]"
                    description: Condition score when provided must be between 0 and 100 inclusive.
                    message: conditionScore must be between 0 and 100.
                    implementation: "!has(this.conditionScore) || this.conditionScore == null || (this.conditionScore >= 0.0 && this.conditionScore <= 100.0)"

                  - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-028
                    type: custom
                    engine: cel
                    severity: WARNING
                    stage: 30
                    order: 12
                    path: "elements[].occurrences[]"
                    description: Grade A occurrences should normally have a conditionScore of at least 85.
                    message: Grade A occurrence has a conditionScore below 85.
                    implementation: "!(has(this.conditionGrade) && this.conditionGrade == 'A' && has(this.conditionScore) && this.conditionScore != null) || this.conditionScore >= 85.0"

                  - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-029
                    type: custom
                    engine: cel
                    severity: WARNING
                    stage: 30
                    order: 13
                    path: "elements[].occurrences[]"
                    description: Grade D occurrences should normally have a conditionScore of 25 or lower.
                    message: Grade D occurrence has a conditionScore above 25.
                    implementation: "!(has(this.conditionGrade) && this.conditionGrade == 'D' && has(this.conditionScore) && this.conditionScore != null) || this.conditionScore <= 25.0"

                  - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-030
                    type: custom
                    engine: cel
                    severity: ERROR
                    stage: 30
                    order: 14
                    path: "elements[].occurrences[]"
                    description: Occurrence surveyLevel must align with parent element assetType.
                    message: Occurrence surveyLevel does not align with parent element assetType.
                    implementation: "(this.surveyLevel == 'Site' && $parent.assetType == 'site') || (this.surveyLevel == 'Block' && $parent.assetType == 'block') || (this.surveyLevel == 'Floor' && $parent.assetType == 'floor') || (this.surveyLevel == 'Space' && $parent.assetType == 'space')"

                  - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-031
                    type: unique
                    engine: unique
                    severity: ERROR
                    stage: 30
                    order: 15
                    path: "elements[].occurrences[]"
                    description: Occurrence id must be unique across all elements.
                    message: Duplicate occurrence id detected in submission.
                    fields:
                      - id

                  - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-032
                    type: unique
                    engine: unique
                    severity: ERROR
                    stage: 30
                    order: 16
                    path: "elements[].occurrences[]"
                    description: Duplicate occurrence combination across productType, surveyLevel, location, and conditionGrade.
                    message: Duplicate occurrence combination detected across productType, surveyLevel, occurrenceExtentOrLocationDescription, and conditionGrade.
                    fields:
                      - "$parent.productType"
                      - surveyLevel
                      - occurrenceExtentOrLocationDescription
                      - conditionGrade

                  - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-033
                    type: custom
                    engine: cel
                    severity: ERROR
                    stage: 30
                    order: 17
                    path: "elements[].occurrences[]"
                    description: Occurrence assessedAt timestamp when specified must not precede survey createdAt.
                    message: Occurrence assessedAt timestamp precedes survey.createdAt.
                    implementation: "!has(this.assessedAt) || this.assessedAt == null || timestamp(this.assessedAt) >= timestamp($root.survey.createdAt)"

                  - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-034
                    type: unique
                    engine: unique
                    severity: WARNING
                    stage: 30
                    order: 18
                    path: "elements[].occurrences[]"
                    description: Advisory uniqueness check across nrm3Code, siteId, blockId, surveyLevel, and location.
                    message: Potential duplicate NRM3 occurrence detected at the same site/block/level/location.
                    fields:
                      - "$parent.nrm3Code"
                      - "$parent.siteId"
                      - "$parent.blockId"
                      - surveyLevel
                      - occurrenceExtentOrLocationDescription

                  - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-038
                    type: custom
                    engine: cel
                    severity: INFO
                    stage: 30
                    order: 19
                    path: "elements[].occurrences[]"
                    description: Advisory notice that all recorded occurrences are included in DfE statutory lifecycle capital forecasting.
                    message: Occurrence included in statutory lifecycle capital forecasting.

                  - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-057
                    type: custom
                    engine: cel
                    severity: WARNING
                    stage: 30
                    order: 20
                    path: "elements[].occurrences[]"
                    description: Completed surveys with 'Assumed' basisOfAssessment should include detailed justification (>= 10 chars).
                    message: Completed survey occurrence with basisOfAssessment 'Assumed' should provide at least 10 characters in conditionDescription.
                    implementation: "!($root.survey.isComplete && has(this.basisOfAssessment) && this.basisOfAssessment == 'Assumed') || (has(this.conditionDescription) && this.conditionDescription != null && size(this.conditionDescription) >= 10)"

                properties:
                  - name: id
                    physicalType: string
                    logicalType: string
                    required: true
                    logicalTypeOptions:
                      pattern: "^OCC-[A-Za-z0-9-]+$"

                  - name: surveyLevel
                    physicalType: string
                    logicalType: string
                    required: true
                    enum:
                      - value: Site
                      - value: Block
                      - value: Floor
                      - value: Space

                  - name: occurrenceExtentOrLocationDescription
                    physicalType: string
                    logicalType: string
                    required: true

                  - name: basisOfAssessment
                    physicalType: string
                    logicalType: string
                    required: false
                    enum:
                      - value: Seen
                      - value: Not Seen
                      - value: Assumed

                  - name: conditionGrade
                    physicalType: string
                    logicalType: string
                    required: false
                    enum:
                      - value: A
                      - value: B
                      - value: C
                      - value: D

                  - name: conditionScore
                    physicalType: number
                    logicalType: number
                    required: false

                  - name: conditionDescription
                    physicalType: string
                    logicalType: string
                    required: false

                  - name: priorityGrade
                    physicalType: string
                    logicalType: string
                    required: false
                    enum:
                      - value: "1"
                      - value: "2"
                      - value: "3"
                      - value: "4"

                  - name: hasAsbestosSuspected
                    physicalType: boolean
                    logicalType: boolean
                    required: false

                  - name: photoReference
                    physicalType: string
                    logicalType: string
                    required: false
                    logicalTypeOptions:
                      pattern: "^PHOTO-[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$"

                  - name: assessedAt
                    physicalType: string
                    logicalType: timestamp
                    required: false

                  - name: replacement
                    logicalType: object
                    required: false
                    quality:
                      - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-035
                        type: custom
                        engine: cel
                        severity: ERROR
                        stage: 40
                        order: 1
                        path: "elements[].occurrences[].replacement"
                        description: Remaining life (remLife) cannot be negative.
                        message: remLife must be greater than or equal to 0.
                        implementation: "!has(this.remLife) || this.remLife == null || this.remLife >= 0"

                      - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-036
                        type: custom
                        engine: cel
                        severity: WARNING
                        stage: 40
                        order: 2
                        path: "elements[].occurrences[].replacement"
                        description: Remaining life (remLife) should not exceed 100 years.
                        message: remLife exceeds typical 100-year maximum lifecycle.
                        implementation: "!has(this.remLife) || this.remLife == null || this.remLife <= 100"

                      - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-037
                        type: custom
                        engine: cel
                        severity: ERROR
                        stage: 40
                        order: 3
                        path: "elements[].occurrences[].replacement"
                        description: Grade D occurrences must report remLife <= 5 years.
                        message: Grade D occurrence cannot have remLife greater than 5 years.
                        implementation: "!(has($parent.conditionGrade) && $parent.conditionGrade == 'D' && has(this.remLife) && this.remLife != null) || this.remLife <= 5"

                      - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-039
                        type: custom
                        engine: cel
                        severity: ERROR
                        stage: 40
                        order: 4
                        path: "elements[].occurrences[].replacement"
                        description: replacementQuantity when provided must be strictly positive.
                        message: replacementQuantity must be greater than 0.
                        implementation: "!has(this.replacementQuantity) || this.replacementQuantity == null || this.replacementQuantity > 0.0"

                      - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-040
                        type: custom
                        engine: cel
                        severity: ERROR
                        stage: 40
                        order: 5
                        path: "elements[].occurrences[].replacement"
                        description: replacementRate when provided must be non-negative.
                        message: replacementRate must be greater than or equal to 0.
                        implementation: "!has(this.replacementRate) || this.replacementRate == null || this.replacementRate >= 0.0"

                      - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-041
                        type: custom
                        engine: cel
                        severity: ERROR
                        stage: 40
                        order: 6
                        dependsOn:
                          - CCD-ELEM-V3-039
                          - CCD-ELEM-V3-040
                        path: "elements[].occurrences[].replacement"
                        description: replacementCost must equal replacementQuantity * replacementRate within automatic float tolerance.
                        message: replacementCost does not match replacementQuantity * replacementRate.
                        implementation: "!has(this.replacementCost) || this.replacementCost == null || !has(this.replacementQuantity) || this.replacementQuantity == null || !has(this.replacementRate) || this.replacementRate == null || this.replacementCost == this.replacementQuantity * this.replacementRate"

                      - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-042
                        type: custom
                        engine: cel
                        severity: ERROR
                        stage: 40
                        order: 7
                        path: "elements[].occurrences[].replacement"
                        description: Unit of measure (uom) must be populated when replacementQuantity is provided.
                        message: replacement.uom is required when replacementQuantity is specified.
                        implementation: "!has(this.replacementQuantity) || this.replacementQuantity == null || (has(this.uom) && this.uom != null)"

                    properties:
                      - name: uom
                        physicalType: string
                        logicalType: string
                        required: false
                        enum:
                          - value: m2
                          - value: m
                          - value: nr
                          - value: item
                          - value: sum

                      - name: remLife
                        physicalType: integer
                        logicalType: integer
                        required: false

                      - name: replacementQuantity
                        physicalType: number
                        logicalType: number
                        required: false

                      - name: replacementRate
                        physicalType: number
                        logicalType: number
                        required: false

                      - name: replacementCost
                        physicalType: number
                        logicalType: number
                        required: false

                  - name: repairs
                    logicalType: array
                    required: false
                    items:
                      logicalType: object
                      quality:
                        - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-019
                          type: custom
                          engine: cel
                          severity: ERROR
                          stage: 50
                          order: 1
                          dependsOn:
                            - CCD-ELEM-V3-001
                          path: "elements[].occurrences[].repairs[]"
                          description: Repair item must be valid for the grandparent element productType.
                          message: repairItem is not in ambient.reference.repair_items_by_product_type for this element's productType.
                          implementation: "has(this.repairItem) && this.repairItem != null && ($parent.$parent.productType in ambient.reference.repair_items_by_product_type) && (this.repairItem in ambient.reference.repair_items_by_product_type[$parent.$parent.productType])"

                        - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-043
                          type: unique
                          engine: unique
                          severity: ERROR
                          stage: 50
                          order: 2
                          path: "elements[].occurrences[].repairs[]"
                          description: Repair id must be unique across all repairs.
                          message: Duplicate repair id detected in submission.
                          fields:
                            - id

                        - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-044
                          type: custom
                          engine: cel
                          severity: ERROR
                          stage: 50
                          order: 3
                          path: "elements[].occurrences[].repairs[]"
                          description: repairQuantity must be strictly positive.
                          message: repairQuantity must be greater than 0.
                          implementation: "has(this.repairQuantity) && this.repairQuantity != null && this.repairQuantity > 0.0"

                        - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-026
                          type: custom
                          engine: cel
                          severity: ERROR
                          stage: 50
                          order: 4
                          dependsOn:
                            - CCD-ELEM-V3-039
                            - CCD-ELEM-V3-044
                          path: "elements[].occurrences[].repairs[]"
                          description: Repair quantity must not exceed parent occurrence replacementQuantity when units match.
                          message: repairQuantity cannot exceed parent replacement.replacementQuantity when using the same uom.
                          implementation: "!has($parent.replacement) || $parent.replacement == null || !has($parent.replacement.replacementQuantity) || $parent.replacement.replacementQuantity == null || !has(this.uom) || this.uom == null || !has($parent.replacement.uom) || $parent.replacement.uom == null || this.uom != $parent.replacement.uom || $parent.replacement.replacementQuantity >= this.repairQuantity"

                        - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-045
                          type: custom
                          engine: cel
                          severity: ERROR
                          stage: 50
                          order: 5
                          path: "elements[].occurrences[].repairs[]"
                          description: Urgent repairs must populate repairDescription and repairClassification.
                          message: repairDescription and repairClassification are required when urgentActionRequired is true.
                          implementation: "!(has(this.urgentActionRequired) && this.urgentActionRequired == true) || (has(this.repairDescription) && this.repairDescription != null && size(this.repairDescription) > 0 && has(this.repairClassification) && this.repairClassification != null)"

                        - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-046
                          type: custom
                          engine: cel
                          severity: ERROR
                          stage: 50
                          order: 6
                          path: "elements[].occurrences[].repairs[]"
                          description: repairItemRate must be non-negative.
                          message: repairItemRate must be greater than or equal to 0.
                          implementation: "has(this.repairItemRate) && this.repairItemRate != null && this.repairItemRate >= 0.0"

                        - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-047
                          type: custom
                          engine: jsonlogic
                          severity: ERROR
                          stage: 50
                          order: 7
                          path: "elements[].occurrences[].repairs[]"
                          description: Annual phased costs (year1Cost through year5Cost) must be non-negative.
                          message: Year 1..5 repair costs must all be greater than or equal to 0.
                          implementation:
                            "and":
                              - ">=": [{ var: year1Cost }, 0]
                              - ">=": [{ var: year2Cost }, 0]
                              - ">=": [{ var: year3Cost }, 0]
                              - ">=": [{ var: year4Cost }, 0]
                              - ">=": [{ var: year5Cost }, 0]

                        - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-048
                          type: custom
                          engine: cel
                          severity: ERROR
                          stage: 50
                          order: 8
                          dependsOn:
                            - CCD-ELEM-V3-044
                            - CCD-ELEM-V3-046
                            - CCD-ELEM-V3-047
                          path: "elements[].occurrences[].repairs[]"
                          description: totalRepairCost must equal the sum of year1Cost..year5Cost within automatic float tolerance.
                          message: totalRepairCost must equal year1Cost + year2Cost + year3Cost + year4Cost + year5Cost.
                          implementation: "this.totalRepairCost == this.year1Cost + this.year2Cost + this.year3Cost + this.year4Cost + this.year5Cost"

                        - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-049
                          type: custom
                          engine: jsonlogic
                          severity: ERROR
                          stage: 50
                          order: 9
                          dependsOn:
                            - CCD-ELEM-V3-044
                            - CCD-ELEM-V3-046
                          path: "elements[].occurrences[].repairs[]"
                          description: totalRepairCost must equal repairQuantity * repairItemRate within automatic float tolerance.
                          message: totalRepairCost must match repairQuantity * repairItemRate.
                          implementation:
                            "==":
                              - var: totalRepairCost
                              - "*":
                                  - var: repairQuantity
                                  - var: repairItemRate

                        - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-050
                          type: custom
                          engine: cel
                          severity: ERROR
                          stage: 50
                          order: 10
                          path: "elements[].occurrences[].repairs[]"
                          description: Classification 'X' (Immediate/Urgent) repairs must schedule non-zero spend in year1Cost.
                          message: year1Cost must be greater than 0 for repairClassification 'X'.
                          implementation: "!(has(this.repairClassification) && this.repairClassification == 'X') || this.year1Cost > 0.0"

                        - id: CCD-ELEM-V3-051
                          type: custom
                          engine: cel
                          severity: WARNING
                          stage: 50
                          order: 11
                          path: "elements[].occurrences[].repairs[]"
                          description: Classification 'Z' (Longer-term) repairs should normally schedule 0 in year1Cost.
